access_and_resolution_notes: Web-tool access failures for some ordinary public pages were followed by bounded public HTTP retrieval, without authentication or bypassing paywalls.
The first metadata reader mishandled gzip responses. It was corrected; decoded primary JSON and later receipts supersede those failures.
The initial LTU PDF prefix and unavailable pypdf parser were superseded by a complete 2.18 MB PDF and successful PyMuPDF extraction.
PAMAP2's legacy ZIP server ignored Range with HTTP 200; transfer was stopped. AICOS-HAR is the verified main data route.
One DocLayNet Hugging Face rows/config route returned 404. The official archive subsequently yielded a complete CRC-checked PNG via Range.
The initially guessed TabICL model identifier failed; the official jingang/TabICL card/API was verified.
DCASE baseline LICENSE filename returned 404. Code reuse is not licensed by assumption; a clean implementation of the published comparator is the fallback.
Complete-member probes distinguish full decoded members from intentionally truncated streams. No model checkpoint or large raw corpus was downloaded.
coverage_limit: Research/data coverage is stronger than consumer-community or buyer evidence. No market trend, representative pain frequency, paid demand or 10–20-year relevance is established.
